name: gcp_iid_comparison
description: Gateway Coordination Protocol IID comparison algorithm per spec GCP-6.3. Conflict resolution requires deterministic lowest-IID comparison.

comparison_algorithm.note: IIDs compared as 8-byte arrays using memcmp (lexicographic byte comparison). This is equivalent to unsigned big-endian u64 comparison.

vectors.name: iid_lower_first_byte
vectors.description: IID differing in first byte: lower first byte wins.

vectors.name: iid_lower_last_byte
vectors.description: IID differing only in last byte: lower last byte wins.

vectors.name: iid_equal
vectors.description: Equal IIDs: tie (should not happen with proper key generation).

vectors.name: iid_zero_vs_nonzero
vectors.description: Zero IID (theoretically possible) wins over any non-zero.

vectors.name: iid_high_bit_comparison
vectors.description: IID with high bit set: unsigned comparison, not signed.
vectors.note: If signed comparison were used, 0x80... would be negative and thus 'less'. Memcmp treats as unsigned.

vectors.name: iid_endian_determinism
vectors.description: Verify big-endian interpretation: 0x0100 < 0x0001 is FALSE in BE.
vectors.note: In little-endian interpretation 0x0100... would be 'larger'. This test ensures BE/memcmp behavior.

vectors.name: iid_realistic_derivation
vectors.description: Realistic IIDs derived from pubkeys: deterministic winner.
